name: cli-commit
description: Generate git commit messages from the Source Control sparkle using Claude CLI or Codex.

cliCommit.provider.description: Which CLI generates the commit message.

cliCommit.claudeModel.markdownDescription: Model passed to `claude --model`. Aliases (`haiku`, `sonnet`, `opus`, `fable`) always resolve to the latest model of that tier, so they never go stale; a full name such as `claude-fable-5` also works. Leave empty to omit the flag and use the CLI's own default. Run **CLI Commit: Select Model** to pick from a list.

cliCommit.codexModel.markdownDescription: Model passed to `codex -m`, e.g. `gpt-5.6-terra`. Leave empty to fall back to the `model` key in your `~/.codex/config.toml`, and then to the CLI's own default. Run **CLI Commit: Select Model** to pick from a list.

cliCommit.effort.description: Reasoning effort passed to the selected CLI.

cliCommit.instructions.description: Optional extra instructions appended to the system prompt (commit style, ticket prefixes, language). Set this in the workspace for repo-specific conventions.

cliCommit.recentCommitCount.description: How many recent commit subjects to include so the model can match this repository's style.

cliCommit.fallbackToUnstaged.description: If nothing is staged, generate from the unstaged working tree diff instead.

cliCommit.fallbackToOtherProvider.description: If the selected CLI fails (rate limits, session limits, outages, missing binary), automatically try the other one.

cliCommit.timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the CLI before cancelling.

cliCommit.claudePath.description: Absolute path to the Claude CLI. Leave empty to auto-detect.

cliCommit.codexPath.description: Absolute path to the Codex CLI. Leave empty to auto-detect.

cliCommit.debug.description: Log prompts, commands, and raw CLI output to the CLI Commit output channel.
